newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS WEDNESDAY EASIER.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS WEDNESDAY EASIER.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar closed Wednesday's interbank session easier on hard units on the back of import pressure, dealers said.
"There was some (foreign currency) buying especially around midsession and towards the close of business and we also saw the central bank buying as well," one dealer said.
The local currency finished the day at 11.3775/3875s sterling compared to 18.9600/9900.
It was at 6.3485/3650 from 6.3200/3400 against the mark and at 2.4975/5075 to the rand from 2.4900/5100.
